settings.heading: Questions, answered
settings.lede: If what you need is not here, write to us. Someone reads all of it.

settings.question: What comes in a full service?
settings.answer: Each collection comes in two sizes of set. Twenty-four pieces: six dinner plates at 27 cm, six dessert plates at 21 cm, six salad plates at 21 cm and slightly deep, and six soup bowls at 12 cm and deep — a service for six. Or sixteen pieces: four of each — a service for four.

settings.question: Can I buy a single piece?
settings.answer: No — each collection is sold only as a complete set, of 24 or 16 pieces. If you need to replace one broken plate, write to us and we will do what we can.

settings.question: Is it dishwasher safe?
settings.answer: Yes, on a gentle cycle at a lower temperature. Not microwave safe, because of the metallic pigment in some of the motifs.

settings.question: Can I mix the collections?
settings.answer: Yes, and it looks better than you would think. The three collections share a palette of coral, sage and warm cream, so a table laid with pieces from all three reads as deliberate rather than accidental.

settings.question: Do you take custom orders?
settings.answer: For larger orders and for restaurants, yes. Write to us with what you have in mind.

settings.question: Do you ship outside Egypt?
settings.answer: Yes, on request. Porcelain needs proper crating, so we quote international shipping individually. Tell us what you want and where it is going.

settings.question: How long until my order arrives?
settings.answer: Inside Egypt, usually two to three working days to pack and two to four to deliver. International timings depend on the destination.

settings.question: Something arrived broken.
settings.answer: Write to us within 48 hours with photographs and we will replace it at no cost.

settings.heading: The things people ask
settings.body: Sizes, care, shipping, and what to expect from the set you receive.
